description:
Time stands still for a small cabin in the forest.
“Welcome, take a rest here.”

In the deep forest, there is a rest stop for travelers.
A boy is looking after the place all alone. Knock. Knock.
“Come in, please” At the kind response of the boy, a cat enters the rest stop and starts to spill out her story.
Knock. Knock. Then a dog, a hamster and a parrot visit the rest stop one by one.
After finishing each animals’ story, the boy opens a map to guide them. Where is the boy leading them to? What is left unsaid by animals?

This is a book to comfort someone who has ever had experience of losing companion animals.

(Source: at noon books)
